name: Sprasa HR
tagline: HR and payroll software built for Nepali organisations: employees, attendance, leave, payroll with Nepali tax, payslips and 21 reports.
highlights: Employee records with PAN, citizenship, SSF / PF / CIT
Shifts, late / overtime minutes, self check-in
Leave workflow with balances and approvals
Payroll: Nepali tax slabs, SSF, payslips, Shrawan fiscal year
21 reports, export to Excel and PDF
